data.one_liner: Manages running external executables within package:build via a temporary directory wrapper.
data.what_it_does: A tool to manage running external executables within package:build by providing a thin wrapper around a temporary directory. It helps add assets to a scratch space, get actual File objects for external binaries, and copy back outputs from the temp directory to the build system.
use_when: You are writing a custom builder that needs to run external command-line executables.
You need to manage temporary directories and asset staging within package:build.
avoid_when: You are building a standard app without custom build_runner builders.
You do not need to interact with external binaries or temporary files.
strengths: Simplifies integration of external binaries into package:build
Provides asset synchronization via digests and helper methods for copying outputs back
weaknesses: Cannot delete individual assets from a scratch space currently, only the entire space
Requires proper handling of temporary resources to avoid filling up the disk
data.setup_notes: Use as a Resource within package:build builders.
